dissent: The two-gate/32-shard Option-E coverage is the chosen conservative reading of the validation contract, not a proven mandate; a reviewer holding once-per-campaign controls to be sufficient would cut required totals substantially.

Binding both mandatory repeats to the most expensive commands is maximally conservative; a policy that fixes cheap named repeat targets would reduce the required ceiling to 6564874 and make 7000000 sufficient with 435126 reserve - the document treats that only as a prospective variant.

The wave07 repair plan's repriced membership path would fit under 5000000 but rests on source changes and two ledger identities that are unadmitted; relying on it before review would repeat the rejected non-additivity claim.
